text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, while 
walking through the shopping district with 
Seeking the Pearl—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*sniff sniff*... Oh my, that smells 
wonderful. Such a rich, mellow aroma of 
aged miso.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Oho, little lady! You've got a sharp nose! 
Got some top-grade miso in stock~. Care to 
take one home?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'd love some! Such a rich aroma... 
It's been aged to perfection. This will 
make for a fabulous miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to try it out right away. I know a 
good spot. Let's go!

In order to cook miso soup, we arrived at 
a nearby barbecue area.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Drinking miso soup in this open atmosphere 
is guaranteed to be très bien!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! What a coincidence, Pearl-san!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing, Taiki. I'm about to 
make some fabulous miso soup right here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What? At a barbecue site? I can't really 
picture it at all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, miso soup is a camping staple, 
after all. Do you know why it's so 
popular?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Soybeans, the base for miso, actually 
help lower cholesterol!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What's・more! The enzymes produced from 
miso will aid your digestion!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a miracle food...! I had no idea at 
aall!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Truly an all-purpose food packed with 
infinite possibilities. I'm honestly 
shocked it hasn't spread worldwide!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So, would you care for a cup as well?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I am veeeery curious, buuut... I ate way 
too much meat, so I can't fit another 
single biiiite!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to give up. Now, close 
your eyes... and cue the music!

"Closing my eyes and focusing on the 
pleasant music, an image began to form in 
my mind...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you can see it too, Trainer-san? It 
feels like an exciting atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's shake the very souls of our 
ingredients with music! First up, the 
angel of the miso soup world—"Tofu"!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Chop with good cheer♪ Now, let's warm you 
to the core~. You'll become nice and 
smooth in no time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Next up is wakame seaweed, packed with 
calcium and magnesium~~! Let all those 
nutrients soak right in~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance the night away with the broth 
in the pot like this♪ Bring on the 
umamiiiii~~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Mash it up with miso right here♪ Hand in 
hand, elevating each other!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the aroma of miso is excellent! Even 
though I'm full... *drool*.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like your hype is bubbling up 
right along with the ingredients, hmm?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let us heighten our passion even further, 
though! The secret to enjoying delicious 
miso soup lies in greeting it with the 
utmost excitement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whooo! MISO soup is the best!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Feel how much your body is craving miso 
soup! Come on, Trainer, you too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Ah, it's starting to 
boil! Let's greet this miso soup with peak 
enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Here we goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Taiki
text_block_list.text: C'mooooooon!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Whew~~. How strange, yes. Even though 
I should be completely full."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It goes down smoothly, simply amazing! 
Such a very gentle flavor, yes♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I aligned your wavelength with the miso 
soup's. See? It tasted delicious, didn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's so delicious I could eat bowls and 
bowls of it♪ The miso soup has such a rich 
flavor, yes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm glad you've come to appreciate 
the charm of miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's a superfood that ought to take flight 
into the wider world! That's miso soup!!
choice_data_list: Everyone ought to know about this!
Everyone ought to know about this!
Where did you learn a technique like that?
Where did you learn a technique like that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's a superfood that ought to take flight 
into the wider world! That's miso soup!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's spread the gospel of miso soup! 
We'll make it a food loved all around the 
world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Let us pursue new ways of making it and 
drawing out its potential, mastering the 
way of miso soup!"

Seeking the Pearl made bowl after bowl of 
miso soup, testing out every conceivable 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's not something I learned. I just 
eyeball the measurements to suit the 
condition of the person eating it. It's a 
one-of-a-kind flavor that can never be 
recreated.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yet it is precisely because this is a 
once-in-a-lifetime encounter that it 
becomes all the more meaningful. Come, let 
us cherish this meeting."

With an expression like a Bodhisattva, 
Seeking the Pearl savored the miso soup 
with deep affection.
